Name: Nemo's Vanilla Magic Skill
Author: Nemoismorethanafish
Description:
Is Ars Venifici complicated? Is Magic Stardew overpowered? I have just the thing for you. Introducing Nemo's Magic Skill, designed to feel like it should have been in the vanilla game.

How it works: At game start you get a Novice Spellbook, just like your other base level tools. As long as the spellbook is in your inventory, you can open it and pick a spell with Q (configurable). You can then cast the spell by using the spellbook just like any other tool.

Magic Skill means Magic Professions! Unlike base game professions, wizards worry little about money, so their professions are focused on improving and diversifying what wizards can do! One path is the Battle Mage, capable of blasting enemies with fireballs to his heart's desire - the other is the Mana Dork, who has more mana for continued casting.

Studying has been overhauled! You can upgrade your spellbook from Novice to Master, which unlocks new spells and reduces their mana cost significantly. In addition, you can upgrade each spell three times. Spells will have unique extra effects at level 3 to make them even more interesting. If you currently need an item for your magic research, it will have the magic icon beside it in your inventory and other menus, so don't worry about memorizing anything new.

Quick Cast: Set your Quick Cast Spell in your Spell Selection Menu with right click, and you can cast that spell on the fly using Z (configurable) so long as your spellbook is on your person. 

You can move the mana bar using Ctrl + Click and Drag. It should remember where you left it. Mana bar does not show up during events, cutscenes, or any time the UI is off now. (Thank you guys for the feedback!) Mana Bar also has improved look! Spells cost less as you upgrade your spellbook.

NEW: Controller is supported!

Feedback is essential in a project like this. Let me know what you think so I can improve it!
